description: This file defines data models and service abstractions for fetching user match data from a backend API in a Flutter application. It includes a data class for match items, an abstract service interface, and two implementations: a mock version for testing and a real HTTP-based version. It also provides a factory function to select the appropriate service based on environment configuration.

classes.name: MatchItem
classes.description: Represents a user match with an identifier, name, and optional photo URL.

classes.name: MatchService
classes.description: Abstract interface defining a method to fetch matches given query parameters.

classes.name: MockMatchService
classes.description: A mock implementation generating deterministic fake match data for testing purposes.

classes.name: HttpMatchService
classes.description: A real implementation that fetches match data from a backend API via HTTP.

methods.name: MatchItem.fromJson
methods.description: Factory to create a MatchItem instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: MatchService.fetchMatches
methods.description: Fetches matches from the backend or mock source based on implementation.

methods.name: MockMatchService.fetchMatches
methods.description: Returns a list of mock MatchItem objects with deterministic data.

methods.name: HttpMatchService.fetchMatches
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to retrieve match data and parses the response.

methods.name: provideMatchService
methods.description: Factory function that provides either a mock or real HTTP match service based on environment configuration.
